arxiv-cl-oai:arXiv.org:2609.22098v1.title: TreeSpark: Enhancing Language-Model Inference with Calibrated, Load-Adaptive Draft Trees
arxiv-cl-oai:arXiv.org:2609.22098v1.summary: TreeSpark, a new approach to speculative decoding, introduces calibrated and load-adaptive draft trees to optimize language-model inference. This method accelerates the process by allowing a cheaper drafter to propose tokens that are then verified in parallel by the target model, significantly improving efficiency without compromising accuracy.

ml-street-talk-yt:video:emTe0M9Yw24.title: Expert Warns: Perfect Models Can Still Mislead in Causal Inference
ml-street-talk-yt:video:emTe0M9Yw24.summary: In a recent video, Frank Hutter, CEO of Prior Labs, discusses the limitations of predictive models in causal inference, highlighting that even perfectly accurate models can lead to incorrect decisions if they fail to account for causality. He uses the example of a medicine and a disease to illustrate how stopping the medicine might not cure the disease, despite the model predicting otherwise.
